A '''slugthrower pistol''' was a weapon that fired metal bullets, also called "[[Slug/Legends|slugs]]," instead of the energy bolts normally fired out of a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. It was a smaller, handheld version of the [[Slugthrower rifle/Legends|slugthrower rifle]]. [[Slugthrower/Legends|Slugthrowers]] were mostly found on backwater fringe worlds where blasters were not commonly found. Their ammunition consisted of a magazine that held 10 slugs. Each magazine cost 20 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and weighed 0.1 [[Kilogram/Legends|kg]].

A standard model of slugthrower pistol was the [[Striker projectile pistol]] manufactured by [[Oriolanis Defense Systems/Legends|Oriolanis Defense Systems]],<ref name="Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook" /> and a slightly larger model was the [[heavy slugthrower pistol]]. Other variants of slugthrower pistols included the [[Adjudicator (slugthrower)|Czerka Adjudicator]], the [[air pistol]], the [[Dissuader KD-30]], the [[Blaster Buster]], the [[.48-caliber Enforcer pistol|Enforcer pistol]], and the [[black-powder pistol]].<ref name="Arms & Equipment Guide">''[[Arms & Equipment Guide]]''</ref> Another variant was the [[Tof Soren Slugthrower Pistol]].
